course.title: Unit 6 An old man tried to move the mountains.【例句】

sentences.content: Hi, Anna. In my Chinese class today, we read a famous story called Yu Gong Moves the Mountains.
sentences.english: Hi , Anna . In my Chinese class today , we read a famous story called Yu Gong Moves the Mountains
sentences.chinese: 你好，Anna。今天在我的中文课上，我们读了一个著名的故事，叫做《愚公移山》。

wordDetails.definition: move（第三人称单数）: 移动

sentences.content: Oh, how does the story begin?
sentences.english: Oh , how does the story begin ?
sentences.chinese: 哦，故事是怎么开始的呢？

wordDetails.definition: do（第三人称单数现在时）: 构成疑问句

sentences.content: Well, once upon a time, there was a very old man.
sentences.english: Well , once upon a time , there was a very old man
sentences.chinese: 话说从前，有一位年迈的老人。

sentences.content: There were two mountains near his house.
sentences.english: There were two mountains near his house
sentences.chinese: 他家附近有两座山。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: They were so high and big that it took a long time to walk to the other side.
sentences.english: They were so high and big that it took a long time to walk to the other side
sentences.chinese: 它们如此高大，以至于走到另一边需要很长时间。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: So what happened next?
sentences.english: So what happened next ?
sentences.chinese: 那么接下来发生了什么？

sentences.content: Well, the old man told his family that they should all help him to move the mountains.
sentences.english: Well , the old man told his family that they should all help him to move the mountains
sentences.chinese: 于是，老人告诉家人，他们应该一起帮他移山。

sentences.content: Hmm, but they probably couldn't even move a small hill.
sentences.english: Hmm , but they probably couldn't even move a small hill
sentences.chinese: 嗯，但他们恐怕连一座小山丘都搬不动。

sentences.content: Yes, that's what I thought, too.
sentences.english: Yes , that's what I thought , too
sentences.chinese: 是的，我也是这么想的。

sentences.content: And where would they put all the earth and stone from the mountains?
sentences.english: And where would they put all the earth and stone from the mountains ?
sentences.chinese: 他们又该如何处理从山上挖出的土石呢？

sentences.content: Yu Gong said they could put it into the sea because it's big enough to hold everything.
sentences.english: Yu Gong said they could put it into the sea because it's big enough to hold everything
sentences.chinese: 愚公说他们可以把土石倒进海里，因为大海宽广足以容纳一切。

sentences.content: So they all started digging the next day.
sentences.english: So they all started digging the next day
sentences.chinese: 于是第二天他们全都开始挖掘。

sentences.content: Let me tell you the rest of the story about Yu Gong.
sentences.english: Let me tell you the rest of the story about Yu Gong
sentences.chinese: 让我来告诉你愚公移山故事的后续。

sentences.content: Yu Gong and his family began to move some of the earth and stone to the sea.
sentences.english: Yu Gong and his family began to move some of the earth and stone to the sea
sentences.chinese: 愚公和他的家人开始把一些土石运往大海。

sentences.content: One day, a man saw Yu Gong and his children when they were working on moving the mountains.
sentences.english: One day , a man saw Yu Gong and his children when they were working on moving the mountains
sentences.chinese: 有一天，一个人看见愚公和他的孩子们正在挖山。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

sentences.content: He told Yu Gong that he could never do it because he was old and weak.
sentences.english: He told Yu Gong that he could never do it because he was old and weak
sentences.chinese: 他告诉愚公，他永远也做不到这件事，因为他年老体弱。

sentences.content: As soon as the man finished talking, Yu Gong said that his family would continue to move the mountains after he died.
sentences.english: As soon as the man finished talking , Yu Gong said that his family would continue to move the mountains after he died
sentences.chinese: 那人话音刚落，愚公就说他死后家人会继续移山。

sentences.content: His family would live and grow, but the mountains could not grow any bigger.
sentences.english: His family would live and grow , but the mountains could not grow any bigger
sentences.chinese: 他的家族会生生不息，但群山却无法再长高半分。

sentences.content: So Yu Gong and his family kept on digging day after day and year after year.
sentences.english: So Yu Gong and his family kept on digging day after day and year after year
sentences.chinese: 于是愚公和他的家人日复一日、年复一年地挖个不停。

sentences.content: Finally, a god was so moved by Yu Gong that he sent another two gods to help take the mountains away.
sentences.english: Finally , a god was so moved by Yu Gong that he sent another two gods to help take the mountains away
sentences.chinese: 最终，一位天神被愚公的精神所感动，便派遣另外两位神明前来相助，移走了大山。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: This story reminds us that you can never know what's possible unless you try to make it happen.
sentences.english: This story reminds us that you can never know what's possible unless you try to make it happen
sentences.chinese: 这个故事提醒我们，除非尝试去实现，否则你永远无法知道什么是可能的。

wordDetails.definition: remind（第三人称单数）: 提醒

sentences.content: So what do you think about the story of Yu Gong?
sentences.english: So what do you think about the story of Yu Gong ?
sentences.chinese: 那么你对愚公的故事有什么看法？

sentences.content: I think it's really interesting.
sentences.english: I think it's really interesting
sentences.chinese: 我觉得这真的很有趣。

sentences.content: Yu Gong found a good way to solve his problem.
sentences.english: Yu Gong found a good way to solve his problem
sentences.chinese: 愚公找到了解决问题的好办法。

sentences.content: Really? I think it's a little bit silly.
sentences.english: Really ? I think it's a little bit silly
sentences.chinese: 真的吗？我觉得这有点傻。

sentences.content: It doesn't seem very possible to move a mountain.
sentences.english: It doesn't seem very possible to move a mountain
sentences.chinese: 移山看起来不太可能。

sentences.content: But the story is trying to show us that anything is possible if you work hard!
sentences.english: But the story is trying to show us that anything is possible if you work hard !
sentences.chinese: 但这个故事试图告诉我们，只要你努力，一切皆有可能！

sentences.content: Yu Gong kept trying and didn't give up.
sentences.english: Yu Gong kept trying and didn't give up
sentences.chinese: 愚公坚持不懈，始终没有放弃。

sentences.content: Well, I still don't agree with you.
sentences.english: Well , I still don't agree with you
sentences.chinese: 嗯，我还是不同意你的看法。

sentences.content: I think we should try to find other ways to solve a problem.
sentences.english: I think we should try to find other ways to solve a problem
sentences.chinese: 我认为我们应该尝试寻找其他方法来解决问题。

sentences.content: But what could Yu Gong do instead of moving the mountains?
sentences.english: But what could Yu Gong do instead of moving the mountains ?
sentences.chinese: 但愚公除了移山还能做什么呢？

wordDetails.definition: 移动（现在分词）: 移动

sentences.content: Well, there are many other ways.
sentences.english: Well , there are many other ways
sentences.chinese: 其实还有很多其他方法。

sentences.content: For example, he could build a road.
sentences.english: For example , he could build a road
sentences.chinese: 例如，他可以修建一条道路。

sentences.content: That's better and faster than moving a mountain!
sentences.english: That's better and faster than moving a mountain !
sentences.chinese: 这比移山还要好、还要快！

sentences.content: You have different opinions about the story, and neither of you are wrong.
sentences.english: You have different opinions about the story , and neither of you are wrong
sentences.chinese: 你们对这个故事有不同的看法，但谁都没有错。

sentences.content: There are many sides to a story and many ways to understand it.
sentences.english: There are many sides to a story and many ways to understand it
sentences.chinese: 一个故事有许多面向，理解它的方式也多种多样。

sentences.content: In November 1979, pupils in England were able to watch a new TV program called Monkey.
sentences.english: In November 1979 , pupils in England were able to watch a new TV program called Monkey
sentences.chinese: 1979年11月，英格兰的学生们得以观看一档名为《Monkey》的新电视节目。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

sentences.content: However, this story is not new to Chinese children.
sentences.english: However , this story is not new to Chinese children
sentences.chinese: 然而，这个故事对中国孩子来说并不新鲜。

sentences.content: The Monkey King or Sun Wukong is the main character in the traditional Chinese book Journey to the West.
sentences.english: The Monkey King or Sun Wukong is the main character in the traditional Chinese book Journey to the West
sentences.chinese: 美猴王或孙悟空是中国传统书籍《西游记》中的主角。

sentences.content: The Monkey King is not just any normal monkey.
sentences.english: The Monkey King is not just any normal monkey
sentences.chinese: 美猴王可不是一只普通的猴子。

sentences.content: In fact, he sometimes does not even look like a monkey!
sentences.english: In fact , he sometimes does not even look like a monkey !
sentences.chinese: 事实上，他有时候甚至看起来都不像只猴子！

sentences.content: This is because he can make 72 changes to his shape and size,

sentences.content: turning himself into different animals and objects.
sentences.english: turning himself into different animals and objects
sentences.chinese: 将自己变成各种动物和物体。

sentences.content: But unless he can hide his tail, he cannot turn himself into a man.
sentences.english: But unless he can hide his tail , he cannot turn himself into a man
sentences.chinese: 但除非他能藏起尾巴，否则就无法变成人形。

sentences.content: To fight bad people, the Monkey King uses a magic stick.
sentences.english: To fight bad people , the Monkey King uses a magic stick
sentences.chinese: 为了对抗坏人，美猴王使用了一根金箍棒。

wordDetails.definition: use（第三人称单数）: 使用

sentences.content: Sometimes he can make the stick so small that he can keep it in his ear.

sentences.content: At other times, he is able to make it big and long.
sentences.english: At other times , he is able to make it big and long
sentences.chinese: 其他时候，他能做得又大又长。

sentences.content: The Monkey King has excited the children of China for many years.
